references.text: Matthew's parallel account where some tell Jesus that his mother and brothers are standing outside and want to speak with him.
Mark's parallel account where Jesus' mother and brothers come and stand outside, sending word for him.
The preceding verse stating that Jesus' mother and brothers came to him but could not reach him because of the crowd.
Jesus' response to the message: He defines his true family as those who hear God's word and do it.
John mentions Jesus' brothers traveling with him and his mother to Capernaum, confirming that Jesus had brothers.
Jesus' brothers are mentioned again, and it is clear they did not believe in him, which may shed light on why they sought him out.
After Jesus' ascension, his mother and brothers were gathered with the disciples in prayer, showing a development in family relationships.
